title: Nikana Prime
extract:
The Nikana Prime is the Primed variant of the  Nikana, acting as a direct upgrade even above the  Dragon Nikana. It was released alongside  Saryn Prime and  Spira Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Decisive Judgement,  Tranquil Cleave,  Blind Justice and  Fateful Truth (Conclave only) stance.
Innate  and  polarity.

Highest critical chance and critical multiplier of all nikanas.
Second fastest attack speed of all nikanas, behind  Skiajati.
Third highest status chance of all nikanas, behind  Syam and Skiajati.

Acquisition

Vaultings
On December 6th, 2017, it was announced that Nikana Prime would enter the Prime Vault and its relics retired from the drop tables on December 12th, 2017, along with  Saryn Prime and  Spira Prime. Any preexisting components or fully-built weapons will remain as is.

Trivia
The Nikana Prime was originally released in July 2015 on the Chinese build of Warframe, along with Excalibur Umbra Prime and  Spira Prime. The Specters of the Rail update made the Nikana Prime and the Spira Prime obtainable by non-Founders.
The Nikana Prime was unintentionally leaked in the Codex following Hotfix 18.4.7 (2016-02-04).
When equipped with the Conclave Nikana Skin, the strip of cloth remains visible, but is moved to the base of the hilt.
As of Update: Specters of the Rail 0.0 (2016-07-08), the default cloth ornament at the end of the hilt is considered a Sugatra and detachable in favor of another. However, there is no current option to have no Sugatra equipped.
The Nikana Prime makes use of Nikana Riven mods and not Dragon Nikana Riven mods, and because the Dragon Nikana has a much higher riven disposition it can generate such mods with higher stats than the Prime variant.
The Nikana Prime's shape and signature red Sugatra is reminiscent of the হেংডাং (Hengdang), a singled edged sword used in the northeastern Indian state of Assam.
With the release of The Old Peace while playing as Excalibur Prime (only for the quest if you don't have the founder's pack) your melee will be a Nikana Prime in a couple sections.
